summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas, a Cayman-domiciled, Miami-based real estate issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held virtually on September 16, 2026. Holders of 22,397,270 of 31,698,635 ordinary shares, roughly 70.65%, voted. Shareholders re-elected Mauricio Salgar and Francoise Lavertu and elected Pablo Ottado as Class II directors for three-year terms, ratified Deloitte Touche, S.A. as 2026 auditor, and approved a general resolution authorizing the CEO, CFO and COO to effect the resolutions. No special-situation transaction, tender, or strategic event is disclosed; a routine AGM outcome with no deal terms.
